title: スクリーン越し、君は渡り鳥のように
author: ネオ・カナタ

en.title: Beyond the Screen, You Are Like a Migratory Bird
en.premise: A story of Nagi, a girl who leaves behind "messages just before disappearing" on the internet, and me, a live streamer. Like a migratory bird that changes its home with the seasons, she constantly "resets" herself, abandoning old accounts to become someone new. One day, drawn by the "digital will" she left behind, I begin to chase the one and only "truth" about the girl on the other side of the screen.

zh.title: 隔着屏幕，你宛如候鸟
zh.premise: 这是一个关于在网络上留下“消失前的最后讯息”的少女——凪，与一名主播——“我”的故事。她如同随季节变换栖息地的候鸟一般，通过弃置账号并不断“重置”，试图成为全新的自己。某一天，围绕着她留下的“数字遗言”，我开始追寻屏幕另一端那个她唯一的“真相”。

prediction_results.question: Nagiが次に残す「消える直前の言葉」は何になる？
prediction_results.reason: 自分を連れ出してほしいという再会の約束のため。
